calls.statement:
SELECT join_date, COUNT(*) AS version_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-08'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT member_key, member_id, join_date, tier, home_store_id, marketing_consent, valid_from, valid_to, is_current
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
ORDER BY member_id, valid_from

SELECT 'multi_joindate_ids' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) > 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'first_valid_from_oct3_but_other_joindate', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id, MIN(valid_from) mv, MIN(join_date) jd FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1) WHERE mv = DATE '2026-10-03' AND jd <> DATE '2026-10-03'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'joindate_oct3_first_valid_from_other', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id, MIN(valid_from) mv, MIN(join_date) jd FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1) WHERE jd = DATE '2026-10-03' AND mv <> DATE '2026-10-03'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_member_key', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'null_joindate', COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'versions_oct3_total', COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from = DATE '2026-10-03'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stg_oct3', COUNT(*) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stg_oct3_not_in_dim', COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'max_joindate', CAST(EXTRACT(day FROM MAX(join_date)) AS BIGINT) FROM dim_member
